premises.text: Existing robotic arms fail on cost, usability, and safety for non-factory use
premises.evidence_span: they're expensive, they're difficult to use, and quite frankly, not that safe

premises.text: Casio is an industrial-capable arm at laptop price with precision motion and customizable attachments
premises.evidence_span: Casio has the capabilities of an industrial arm, but the price of a laptop

premises.text: Guide-through training and consumer interfaces remove the need for advanced degrees
premises.evidence_span: Simply guide the arm through a motion that it plays back perfectly

premises.text: Novel full-coverage proximity sensors keep the arm safe around humans
premises.evidence_span: we've invented a new type of sensor. It can detect a human up to 20 inches away in any direction from any point on the arm

premises.text: APIs turn Cassia into a developer platform anyone who can build a website can use
premises.evidence_span: Our APIs cut the complexity, so if you can build a website, you can code for Cassia

domains.name: Casio arm product (price, performance, safety, training)

value.text: Enable new robotic applications by making arms ubiquitous like computers
value.evidence_span: to enable these new types of applications, and ultimately to make robotic arms as ubiquitous as computers

causal_links.evidence_span: We've created Casio, our kick-ass, trainable, intelligent arm that solves all three problems
when you give people incredible tools, they can do incredible things
